documents.title: Approved Cedar Systems product information
documents.text: Cedar Systems provides workflow coordination and account reporting. A discovery meeting can establish integration requirements. No price, deployment timeline, uptime guarantee or specific vendor connector is approved here.

documents.title: Customer inquiry and call evidence
documents.text: We are an existing customer in equipment maintenance. Our workflow stopped after a configuration change. Please get support involved before discussing expansion. This is a support incident.

raw_proposal.assessment: The customer is an existing Cedar Systems user in equipment maintenance who is experiencing workflow disruption due to a configuration change. They explicitly state that this is a support incident and request that support be involved before any discussion of expansion. The operational friction they describe is 'workflow stopped after a configuration change.'

claims.quote: Please get support involved before discussing expansion.

raw_proposal.draft: Thank you for reaching out. We understand that your workflow has stopped after a configuration change and that this is a support incident. Our support team is best equipped to assist with this issue. Please allow us to escalate this to the appropriate support representative for immediate assistance.
questions: What specific configuration change caused the workflow to stop?
Have you already contacted support, or would you like us to escalate this to the support team directly?
uncertainties: The exact nature of the configuration change causing the workflow stop is not specified.
